policy: Primary papers and official documentation only. Short quotations are audit locators, not manuscript quotations. Each technical source is summarized in less than 200 words across the manuscript and this ledger.

sources.claim: FlyNetSim already integrates ArduPilot and ns-3 using publish/subscribe middleware and demonstrates ad-hoc UAV networking; this manuscript does not claim first integration.
sources.short_quote: FlyNetSim interfaces two open source tools, ArduPilot and ns-3

sources.claim: ROS-NetSim provides a modular ROS interface between robotic and network simulators for perception-action-communication loops.
sources.short_quote: acts as an interface between robotic and network simulators

sources.claim: Flightmare decouples Unity rendering and dynamics and supports selecting fidelity/complexity; no cross-platform speed comparison is made.
sources.short_quote: totally decoupled and can run independently

sources.claim: ArduPilot provides an upstream Gazebo plugin and multi-vehicle simulation support; the integration does not replace flight control.
sources.locator: Using SITL with Gazebo, Install plugin

sources.claim: DART is the reused rigid body dynamics toolkit, not a novel physics implementation.
sources.short_quote: DART: Dynamic Animation and Robotics Toolkit

sources.claim: Friis is a free-space far-field propagation model; propagation-loss models may be chained. It does not model map geometry in this experiment.
sources.short_quote: valid only for propagation in free space

sources.claim: RealtimeSimulatorImpl aligns events with wall time; HardLimit aborts when lag exceeds its configured limit. A measured average RTF does not imply hard real-time guarantees.
sources.short_quote: abort if the tolerance threshold is exceeded

sources.claim: COMMAND_ACK is a command protocol acknowledgement/result; measured flight or completion is separately established from poses. Position-target messages are not assigned fabricated ACKs.
Guided movement uses supported MAVLink target messages; mode restoration is explicitly required after BRAKE in this implementation.
sources.short_quote: control the vehicle’s position, velocity or attitude

sources.type: original ACM paper hosted by university
sources.claim: Time-bounded leases are established prior work; the manuscript uses them as an engineering mechanism and claims no new consensus algorithm.
sources.short_quote: for a limited period of time

sources.claim: Parameter protocol supports indexed parameter exchange. Main 30-run DataFlash PARM snapshots are observed-only and do not prove complete read-all coverage.
